_about: redactSecrets(text) (Python redact_secrets, Go wakeshift.RedactSecrets), design §4: every Wakeshift secret format in text becomes [redacted]. Each SDK's result must equal want exactly for every vector, and redacting want again must give want. Prefixed tokens (wst_ app keys and connector tickets, wsc_ session keys, wsp_ publish URL tokens, whsec_ signing secrets, wkt1_ wait-task IDs, wsv_ subscribe vouchers) and compact JWS/JWT (eyJ…) become [redacted] whole. Stream links keep their key: link=, link%3D (either case) and "link":" (also JSON-escaped) stay and only the value becomes [redacted]. All test values are fake.

rules.token_characters: A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - + / = and %XX (a percent and two hex digits, so URL-encoded + / = stay inside the token)
rules.prefixed: wst_, wsc_, wsp_, whsec_, wkt1_ or wsv_ (lowercase), then at least 6 token characters; no leading word boundary, so %22wsc_… and xwsc_… match
rules.jws: eyJ, at least 4 token characters, a dot, at least 4 token characters, a dot, then any number of token characters (an empty signature matches)
rules.link_query: link= or link%3D / link%3d, not preceded by an ASCII letter unless that letter ends a %XX escape (unlink= is left alone; %3Flink%3D matches), then one or more token characters or dots
rules.link_json: "link", optional spaces, :, optional spaces, ", then everything up to the next " or backslash; and the same with every quote escaped as \"

_reference_comment: A reference, not an export: one RE2-compatible pattern (Go regexp, JavaScript and Python re accept it). Group 1 and 2: the character before link and the link= or link%3D key, kept; group 3: the JSON "link":" prefix, kept with its closing quote; group 4: the JSON-escaped prefix, kept with its closing \". Any other match becomes [redacted] whole. The vectors are the contract; an SDK may implement them however it likes, and never exports a mutable regular expression.
